caption: The drawing depicts a rectangular, woven-pattern design composed of intersecting vertical and horizontal segments in a grid arrangement. The primary colors used are shades of red, blue, and beige. The red and blue elements form various rectangular and square shapes of different sizes, with repeating and alternating core patterns, such as solid blocks, ovals, and small squares. The beige sections separate and accentuate the colored shapes, making a checkered effect. The drawing is centrally placed on a plain, off-white background, leaving wide margins around the patterned composition. The bottom right corner of the drawing features a signature, "C. Christoffels." No discernible objects or figures apart from the abstract pattern are present.
title: Coverlet (Section)
cluster: #22 — Domestic Textiles: Coverlets, Tablecloths, and Rugs
